title: PAY-002 Commerce Order API Admission Gate
purpose: Admission gate for the candidate Commerce Order create/read DTOs; this contract does not itself enable public routes.

requiredEvidence.requirement: Both candidate methods and exact paths are added to Canonical OpenAPI with closed request/response DTO schemas, common error envelopes and body size limits.
order.create.own and order.read.own are formally admitted to contracts/authz/permissions.json and CASL/role policy with owner scope; unauthorized and cross-owner reads are rejected.
W07 resolves every submitted itemRef to an authoritative purchasable item/offer, immutable version and current price; unsupported/unavailable items fail closed.
Create/read response DTO fields map deterministically to ENT-ORDER and ENT-ORDER-LINE without exposing customerId, internal columns, or provider/ledger/entitlement internals.
Read-only D1-04 UUID/display-name preflight and reviewed physical schema/migration evidence pass before runtime writes are enabled.
Same key and same semantic request replays the original order response; same key and a different request hash is rejected, atomically with order creation.
The route enforces a bounded request-body size, item-count and quantity limits, plus existing W01/W07 anti-abuse controls before any D1 write.

Exact-commit runtime tests cover successful create/read, malformed/unknown fields, price spoofing, missing idempotency key, replay/key-reuse conflict, owner isolation, unavailable items and concurrency/recovery.
Schema, migration, security and runtime evidence is admitted against the exact implementation commit; PAY-002 remains unresolved until downstream mapping checks pass.

greenRule: This gate cannot be GREEN while any required evidence is PENDING; route publication and implementation admission are separate from a valid candidate DTO.
nextAction: Admit the candidate permission IDs and canonical OpenAPI operation/DTO mapping, then implement through the W01 public API boundary to W07.
